Ark was such a flash in the pan. It has some amazing original ideas and an incredibly fun gameplay loop around taking dinos and using them to explore new areas or produce materials to boost your build. But I can't recommend it after the most recent updates. It was a bit of a buggy mess to begin with, but the team was responsive and usually tried to fix things where they could. I don't know anything about the studio being bought and whatnot, but you can tell the care for the players left. 
There are so many good games that can scratch the same itch now. If you like the open world survival and boss fights, valheim is an incredible game. If you like the creatur capture aspect, give palworld a try honestly.

Man, this game is surprisingly great. I craved to play this game since it released but i got to play only after waiting for it for whole 9 years. After i bought it and installed it, My level of happiness was so high that other times in my life i had became happy were nowhere around this level. I recommend you playing this game if you like playing survival games like minecraft but with higher graphics. Moreover, i am not especially into survival type games cuz i feel they are boring to grind. *BUT* ,,, ARK  is different. I played this cuz i was into dinosaurs from my childhood. If you are looking for a survival premordial time game with tip top graphics, I recommend you playing this game, Either evolved or if your pc can handle ascended. Download and *ENJOY* your time in the world of *ARK*.
Honestly has insane potential, if only they would lock in. I personally have no issues with it other than that, and I love the game as much as one can love wasted potential ):
